name: Vesicular-Arete
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a nearby asteroid belt, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
For traders, nitrogen, water and helium-3 alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
